objectives: Explain why Abraham called Sarah his sister again.
Show that adultery was sin long before Exodus 20.
takeaways: Abraham said she is my sister for fear of being killed for his wife's sake, as he had in Egypt.
God warned Abimelech in a dream: thou art but a dead man, for the woman is a man's wife.
Adultery is one of the weightier matters; there is no animal sacrifice that atones for it.
The Lord closed up the wombs of Abimelech's house because of Sarah; He does not play about the prophet's wife.
